components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Sacco Blue action button — the default affordance for act-here.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #0050D8; color: #fff; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(0,80,216,0.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,80,216,0.5); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: Harvest Gold — one key CTA per screen (The Gold Budget Rule).
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #C9A84C; color: #fff; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #B8973B; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(201,168,76,0.5); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action — hairline border, quiet until hovered.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 36px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #fff; color: #111827; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #F9FAFB; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,80,216,0.3); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Standard field — hairline border, 3px focus ring, no glow.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; min-width: 220px; padding: 4px 12px; background: transparent; color: #111827; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 6px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); transition: border-color 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6B7280; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: #0050D8; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,80,216,0.5); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Resting surface — white, 12px radius, soft lift.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid #E5E7EB; border-radius: 12px; padding: 24px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 8px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #111827; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-size: 14px; color: #374151; } .ds-num { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-weight: 600; color: #111827; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Active state: sky tint background + Sacco Blue label.
components.html: MembersSavingsLoans
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 200px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: block; padding: 8px 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: #374151; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: #F9FAFB; } .ds-nav-item.ds-active { background: rgba(83,179,218,0.15); color: #0050D8; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(0,80,216,0.3); }

narrative.overview: Mfuko Pro is the modern successor to the member's trusted passbook: every number verifiable, every entry traceable, nothing decorative standing between a teller and the transaction. Modern, efficient and professional — competence expressed through speed and clarity, not gloss. Density is welcome but hierarchy always makes the primary figure and the next action obvious.
keyCharacteristics: One typeface (Inter Variable) everywhere, tabular figures for money
Sacco Blue carries identity and primary actions; Harvest Gold is the warm counterpoint for key CTAs
Flat surfaces with soft lift: shadow-sm at rest, stronger shadows only for overlays
Refined and restrained controls — color signals action and state, never decoration
Dark mode is a first-class citizen

rules.name: The Verifiable Figure Rule
rules.body: Money is never colored for decoration. Green means credit/positive, red means debit/negative, ink means neutral — and every colored figure must be traceable to a ledger entry.

rules.name: The Gold Budget Rule
rules.body: Harvest Gold appears on at most one primary action per screen. When everything is gold, nothing is.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Inter Variable is the only font family in the product. No monospace, no serif, no per-component font imports. Numeric columns use tabular-nums, not a second font.

rules.name: The Stat Ceiling Rule
rules.body: Sizes above 24px (text-3xl, text-4xl) are reserved for dashboard stat figures, never headings.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: If a resting card casts a visible shadow from across the room, it's wrong. Reserve real elevation for things that float above the page.

dos: Do use Inter Variable for everything; tabular-nums on every monetary column.
Do keep body text ≥4.5:1 contrast — bump Text Muted (#6B7280) toward ink on tinted backgrounds.
Do scope color to action and state: blue = act/active, gold = key CTA, green/red = credit/debit.
Do give every interactive component default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, loading and error states.
Do use skeletons for loading and empty states that teach the interface.
donts: Don't recreate legacy banking software: no cluttered gray form walls, tiny fonts, or 90s core-banking density.
Don't drift into the generic admin template look — interchangeable Bootstrap/AdminLTE surfaces.
Don't use side-stripe borders (border-left > 1px as accent), gradient text, or glassmorphism.
Don't color money decoratively — see The Verifiable Figure Rule.
Don't put more than one Harvest Gold action on a screen — see The Gold Budget Rule.
Don't add decorative motion; 150-250ms state transitions only, with prefers-reduced-motion alternatives.
